gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-arimo: Arimo stands tall and tidy, its rounded shapes leaving generous gaps at the terminals. Arimo's best trick is staying out of the way while Outrun Future, wide-set and synthwave to the core, takes all the attention.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-armata: A stencil-cut channel of constant weight gives Outrun Future its authority, with letters spaced far apart. Armata fills its lowercase up toward the cap height, giving the wide-set heading something sturdy to lean on.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-atkinson-hyp: Outrun Future bends its constant-width line like sign wire, wide-set and synthwave in mood. And Atkinson Hyperlegible brings wide-set terminals on its s and ascenders clipped short beside the lowercase.

Zero swing in stroke weight defines Outrun Future, a wide-set synthwave voice with real authority. Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono does the other job, letting open counters breathe in the white space while the heading simply commands.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-biryani: Biryani reads clean and approachable, with a large eye on every e and small counters that never clog. Outrun Future supplies wide-set synthwave swagger while Biryani stays out of its way.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-blinker: Blinker keeps its lines steady and its apertures open, with lowercase filling most of the height. Blinker stays comfortable down a full column, leaving the wide-set drama to Outrun Future.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-carrois-goth: Outrun Future moves its curves and stems in lockstep, wide-set and authoritative with a synthwave streak. Carrois Gothic brings a modern, professional counterweight, its x-height set high and its c opened generously.

Spaghetti-like lines laid out as letters make Outrun Future unmistakable. Carrois Gothic SC supplies the quieter half, with capitals and lowercase nearly the same height and a clear opening at every curve's end.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-chivo: Steady and unshaded: Outrun Future draws a wide-set synthwave outline, while Chivo packs its lowercase up toward the caps. Daylight shows through every curve of the sans beside it.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-chocolate-cl: Authoritative from the first word, Outrun Future ends every terminal at the width it began, wide-set throughout. And Chocolate Classical Sans adds a sizable lowercase and a broad-nibbed stroke that never curls shut.
